detail.sDescription: A modified OCA-EW 626 with a faster reload and a silencer.

eFnMod_0.sDescription:
Magazine Modification -
Rubberized loops on the magazines allow them to be handled easier, greatly improving reload times.

aModifierEffects.sDescription: <Color:R=0 G=1 B=0>-40%<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1> reload time
<Color:R=1 G=0 B=0>-20%<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1> magazine capacity

eFnMod_1.sDescription:
Barrel Modification -
A Suppressor helps reduce muzzle flare and dampens sound. Reduced muzzle velocity caused by the extra friction of the suppressor however makes the weapon slightly less effective when hitting hard targets such as vehicles.

aModifierEffects.sDescription: <Color:R=1 G=0 B=0>-10%<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1> damage to vehicles

eAmmoCategory.sDescription: Specialized ammunition for use with automatic machine guns.
